notes.title: Fallen Empires will release in 5 days!
notes.notes:
Play Fallen Empires on sale September 30! Last minute testers still needed - comment below to join the beta.

Online multiplayer servers already live. Join the multiplayer launch event TBA.

notes.title: Update on Release Date
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Due to unforeseen circumstances in the development process, the game's release date will be pushed back until later this summer.

We want to provide you with the best possible product, and will require more time to ensure the gameplay is the best it can be.

If don't want to wait and you're interested in playing the pre-release beta version, please comment below and I will send you a beta key when available.

I thank you all very much for your patience and interest. 
 
-Chris

Lead Developer
